dt.month == 12\n        and dt.day == 31\n    )\n\n\ndef main(params):\n\n    OUTDATA = params.get(\n        \"OUTDATA\",\n        []\n    )\n\n    if not isinstance(\n        OUTDATA,\n        list\n = []\n\n        # =========================\n        # 获取频率和截止日期\n        # =========================\n\n        frequency = str(\n            data.get(\n                \"indicator_release_frequency\"\n            ) or \"\"\n        ).strip()\n\n        end_date = data.get(\n            \"end_date\"\n        )\n\n        # =========================\n        # 规则1：月频\n        # =========================\n\n        if frequency == \"月\":\n\n            if not is_empty(\n                end_date\n            ):\n\n                if not is_month_end(\n       # =========================\n\n        elif frequency == \"季\":\n\n            if not is_empty(\n                end_date\n            ):\n\n                if not is_quarter_end(\n                    end_date\n                ):\n\n                    remarks.append(\n                        \"截止日期不是季末\"\n                    )\n\n        # =========================\n        # 规则3：半年频\n        # =========================\n\n        elif frequency == \"半年\":\n\n            if not is_empty(\n                end_date\n            ):\n\n                if not is_half_year_end(\n                    end_date\n                ):\n\n                    remarks.append(\n                        \"截止日期不是半年末\"\n                    )\n\n        # =========================\n        # 规则4：年频\n        # =========================\n\n        elif frequency == \"年\":\n\n            if not is_empty(\n                end_date\n            ):\n\n                if not is_year_end(\n                    end_date\n                ):\n\n                    remarks.append(\n                        \"截止日期不是年末\"\n                    )\n\n        # =========================\n        # 有异常则进入warningdata\n        # =========================\n\n        if remarks:\n\n            warning_item = data.copy()\n\n            warning_item[\n                \"remark\"\n            ] = \"；\".join(\n                remarks\n            )\n\n            warningdata.append(\n                warning_item\n            )\n\n    # =========================\n    # 没有异常时生成占位数据\n    # =========================\n\n    if params.scriptCode:
def main(params):
    data = params.get("GZK", {})

    codes = data.get("ZBDM", [])
    names = data.get("ZBMC", [])
    constants = data.get("ZBDW", [])
    ratios = data.get("unit_ratio", [])
    frequencies = data.get("indicator_release_frequency", [])

    max_len = max(
        len(codes),
        len(names),
        len(constants),
        len(ratios),
        len(frequencies)
    )

    GZKJG = []

    for i in range(max_len):
        GZKJG.append({
            "rule_indicator_code": codes[i] if i < len(codes) else "",
            "rule_indicator_name": names[i] if i < len(names) else "",
            "rule_constant_name": constants[i] if i < len(constants) else "",
            "rule_unit_ratio": ratios[i] if i < len(ratios) else "",
            "indicator_release_frequency": frequencies[i] if i < len(frequencies) else ""
        })

    return {
        "GZKJG": GZKJG
    }

import re

# ======================
# 判断是否为数字
# ======================
def check_number(value):
    if value is None:
        return False
    value = str(value).strip()
    if value == "":
        return False
    return re.match(r"^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$", value) is not None

def main(params):
    # ======================
    # 获取采集数据
    # ======================
    indicator_name = (params.get("indicator_name") or "").strip()
    indicator_data = params.get("indicator_data")

    if not check_number(indicator_data):
        indicator_data = "empty"

    indicator_unit = params.get("indicator_unit") or ""
    end_date = params.get("end_date") or ""
    publictime = params.get("publictime") or ""
    remark = params.get("remark") or ""
    rid = params.get("rid") or ""

    # ======================
    # 获取规则库
    # ======================
    GZKJG = params.get("GZKJG", [])

    OUTDATA = []
    matched = False
    KB_unit = ""

    # ======================
    # 指标匹配
    # ======================
    for rule in GZKJG:
        rule_name = (
            rule.get("rule_indicator_name") or ""
        ).strip()

        if rule_name == indicator_name:
            matched = True

            KB_unit = (
                rule.get("rule_constant_name") or ""
            )

            OUTDATA.append({
                "indicator_code": str(
                    rule.get("rule_indicator_code") or ""
                ),
                "indicator_name": indicator_name,
                "indicator_data": indicator_data,
                "indicator_unit": indicator_unit,
                "unit_ratio": str(
                    rule.get("rule_unit_ratio") or ""
                ),
                "indicator_release_frequency": rule.get(
                    "indicator_release_frequency",
                    ""
                ),
                "end_date": end_date,
                "rid": rid,
                "publictime": publictime,
                "remark": remark
            })

    # ======================
    # 未匹配处理
    # ======================
    if not matched:
        OUTDATA.append({
            "indicator_code": "empty",
            "indicator_name": indicator_name,
            "indicator_data": indicator_data,
            "indicator_unit": indicator_unit,
            "unit_ratio": "",
            "indicator_release_frequency": "",
            "end_date": end_date,
            "rid": rid,
            "publictime": publictime,
            "remark": remark
        })

    # ======================
    # 输出
    # ======================
    return {
        "OUTDATA": OUTDATA,
        "KB_unit": KB_unit
    }

import calendar
import datetime


def has_value(value):
    """判断字段是否有值"""

    if value is None:
        return False

    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip() != ""

    return True


def parse_date(value):
    """
    将常见日期格式转换为 date。
    解析失败返回 None。
    """

    if value is None:
        return None

    if isinstance(value, datetime.datetime):
        return value.date()

    if isinstance(value, datetime.date):
        return value

    text = str(value).strip()

    if not text:
        return None

    formats = [
        "%Y-%m-%d",
        "%Y/%m/%d",
        "%Y.%m.%d",
        "%Y年%m月%d日",
        "%Y年%m月%d号",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
        "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
    ]

    for fmt in formats:
        try:
            return datetime.datetime.strptime(
                text,
                fmt
            ).date()
        except ValueError:
            continue

    # ISO格式兜底
    try:
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(
            text.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        ).date()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return None


def is_month_end(value):
    """
    判断是否为月末。
    """

    dt = parse_date(value)

    if dt is None:
        return False

    last_day = calendar.monthrange(
        dt.year,
        dt.month
    )[1]

    return dt.day == last_day


def is_quarter_end(value):
    """
    判断是否为季末。

    合法日期：
    03-31
    06-30
    09-30
    12-31
    """

    dt = parse_date(value)

    if dt is None:
        return False

    return (
        dt.month in (3, 6, 9, 12)
        and is_month_end(dt)
    )


def is_half_year_end(value):
    """
    判断是否为半年末。

    合法日期：
    06-30
    12-31
    """

    dt = parse_date(value)

    if dt is None:
        return False

    return (
        dt.month in (6, 12)
        and is_month_end(dt)
    )


def is_year_end(value):
    """
    判断是否为年末。

    合法日期：
    12-31
    """

    dt = parse_date(value)

    if dt is None:
        return False

    return (
        dt.month == 12
        and dt.day == 31
    )


def add_remark(remarks, remark):
    """
    添加remark，相同remark不重复。
    """

    if remark not in remarks:
        remarks.append(remark)

            )

        # ==================================================
        # 规则3：
        # 信息发布日期不能小于截止日期
        # ==================================================

        if (
            publictime_date is not None
            and end_date_obj is not None
            and publictime_date < end_date_obj
        ):

            add_remark(
                remarks,
                "信息发布日期-信息发布日期小于截止日期"
            )

        # ==================================================
        # 规则4：
        # indicator_release_frequency
        # 根据披露频率判断对应周期末
        # ==================================================

        if end_date_obj is not None:

            # =========================
            # 月频
            # =========================

            if indicator_release_frequency == "月":

                if not is_month_end(
                    end_date_obj
                ):

                    add_remark(
                        remarks,
                        "截止日期不是月末"
                    )

            # =========================
            # 季频
            # =========================

            elif indicator_release_frequency == "季":

                if not is_quarter_end(
                    end_date_obj
                ):

                    add_remark(
                        remarks,
                        "截止日期不是季末"
                    )

            # =========================
            # 半年频
            # =========================

            elif indicator_release_frequency == "半年":

                if not is_half_year_end(
                    end_date_obj
                ):

                    add_remark(
                        remarks,
                        "截止日期不是半年末"
                    )

            # =========================
            # 年频
            # =========================

            elif indicator_release_frequency == "年":

                if not is_year_end(
                    end_date_obj
                ):

                    add_remark(
                        remarks,
                        "截止日期不是年末"
                    )

        # ==================================================
        # 规则5：
        # problem_fin_time 独立判断
        #
        # 1002 → 月末
        # 1003 → 季末
        # 1004 → 年末
        # ==================================================

        if (
            has_value(
                problem_fin_time
            )
            and end_date_obj is not None
        ):

            problem_text = str(
                problem_fin_time
            )

            # =========================
            # 1002：必须为月末
            # =========================

            if (
                "1002" in problem_text
                and not is_month_end(
                    end_date_obj
                )
            ):

                add_remark(
                    remarks,
                    "非月末数据"
                )

            # =========================
            # 1003：必须为季末
            # =========================

            if (
                "1003" in problem_text
                and not is_quarter_end(
                    end_date_obj
                )
            ):

                add_remark(
                    remarks,
                    "非季末数据"
                )

            # =========================
            # 1004：必须为年末
            # =========================

            if (
                "1004" in problem_text
                and not is_year_end(
                    end_date_obj
                )
            ):

                add_remark(
                    remarks,
                    "非年末数据"
                )

        # ==================================================
        # 有任意异常
        # → 放入 warningdata
        # ==================================================

        if remarks:

            warning_item = data.copy()

            warning_item[
                "remark"
            ] = "；".join(
                remarks
            )

            warningdata.append(
                warning_item
            )

    # ==================================================
    # 没有异常
    # → 生成 empty 占位
    # ==================================================

    if not warningdata:

        warningdata.append({
            "indicator_code": "empty",
            "indicator_name": "empty",
            "indicator_data": "empty",
            "end_date": "",
            "publictime": "",
            "indicator_release_frequency": "",
            "problem_fin_time": "",
            "remark": ""
        })

    # ==================================================
    # 输出
    # ==================================================

    return {
        "OUTDATA": OUTDATA,
        "warningdata": warningdata
    }
